from unittest import TestCase

class SymptomTest(TestCase):

    def test_add_symptom(self):
        # Add a new symptom with valid data
        symptom_name = "Headache"
        description = "Constant pain in the head"

        # Call the function to add the symptom
        add_symptom(symptom_name, description)

        # Assert that the symptom was added successfully
        self.assertEqual(get_symptom_by_name(symptom_name), symptom_name)

    def test_view_symptom_details(self):
        # Get the symptom details for an existing symptom
        symptom_name = "Headache"

        # Call the function to get the symptom details
        symptom_details = get_symptom_by_name(symptom_name)

        # Assert that the symptom details are correct
        self.assertEqual(symptom_details["description"], "Constant pain in the head")

    def test_delete_symptom(self):
        # Delete a symptom that is not used in any consultation request
        symptom_name = "Headache"

        # Call the function to delete the symptom
        delete_symptom(symptom_name)

        # Assert that the symptom was deleted successfully
        self.assertIsNone(get_symptom_by_name(symptom_name))

    def test_delete_symptom_with_consultation_request(self):
        # Try to delete a symptom that is used in a consultation request
        symptom_name = "Fever"

        # Call the function to delete the symptom
        with self.assertRaises(Exception):
            delete_symptom(symptom_name)
